verdicts.reason: A: the black panel has shrunk to a tiny 'MOVIE NIGHT' chip, and all the white body text (GROUNDHOG DAY, tagline, date, address, URL) sits straight on the busy doodle background with no backing, so it is almost entirely illegible and collides with the masks and phone. B: the panel is a small orphaned box holding only the title, and the white text is scattered across the canvas (title at the top edge, tagline mid-right, date, address, URL near the bottom) over line art, so it cannot be read and there is no reading order. Both are unusable. A is slightly less bad because its text stays in one group in the original order.
